Payout of 29 July is short ₹12,378.00.
The bank credited ₹5,23,540.78 against an expected ₹5,35,918.78. 22 orders sit in this payout. No refund, chargeback or payment in the gateway ledger accounts for the difference, so the cause is not yet identified.
Suggested action: request the gateway's own breakdown for this payout, and check for a dispute debited but not yet reported.
